description.fallback: Boruto and the Konoha shinobi are surrounded by the growing number of divided Mamushi. Sumire asks the status of Sarada, with Boruto confirming that she is still breathing but worried how her usage of the Mangekyō Sharingan is effecting her vision. Himawari arrives to heal her injuries and stop the bleeding.
